title: Three Autumns and One Short Note
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（人与自我·做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（人与自我·做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：intention　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 intention 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the writer ① stated the intention that no friend in the study would have recorded, and he said the stating was the whole of the autumn. The ② intention, meaning the aim itself and not the page, ran three autumns and stayed unrecorded in the book; intention, he said, is the only thing in a study that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kind of intention in that study had the same short page beside it, and the ④ intention at the far window, meaning the word they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Intention, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the writer said the recording is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the intention was the whole of the matter, meaning the promise and not the aim. The ⑥ intention, meaning the promise and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; intention, he said, is either something you state or the only word that means both aim and a promise. He said the promise is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ intention had become a line in a note, and the note had become an argument about the short page. The ⑧ intention of the whole thing, the writer wrote in April, was one study and three autumns of recording; intention, he said, is either the word at the far window or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ intention I remember is the intention recorded in the note, which closed in 1975 and is still recorded as the quietest in the study. ⑩ Intention, my mother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all intention, she said, is a promise that has agreed to look like aim. She said the promise was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 意图；打算（指书房里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 意图；打算（指那个心意本身，与一页相对）
C. 固定搭配：state the intention 表明这个意图
D. n. 意图；打算（指留给孩子们抄的一句那一个）
E. n. 初衷之事（抽象总称，指一处书房的意图之事）
F. n. 意图；打算（指便条里写到、被记下的的那一个）
G. n. 承诺、心意（指一件事里人人都打算却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 心意（抽象总称，指人人都打算却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: stated the intention that no friend in the study would have recorded
The intention, meaning the aim itself and not the page

the intention at the far window

answers.why: state the intention 意为“表明这个意图”，1968 年那位作者把书房里没有一位朋友肯记录的一个意图做了一遍。
intention 意为“意图；打算”，指那个心意本身而不是一页，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被记录。
intention 意为“意图；打算”，指书房里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一页薄薄的一页。
intention 意为“意图；打算”，指最远那扇窗边留给孩子们抄的一句那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
intention 意为“承诺、心意”，指一件事里人人都打算却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份心意就是那件事的全部。
intention 意为“心意”，指人人都打算却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个心意，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
intention 意为“意图；打算”，指便条里写到、被记下的的那一个，到 1973 年这一个成了便条里的一行。
intention 意为“初衷之事”，作者四月写道，整件事的意图之事是一处书房和三个秋天的记录。
intention 意为“意图；打算”，我记得的是便条里记录过的那一个，1975 年落定了，至今仍被说成书房里最安静的一个。
intention 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，意图是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的心意。
